|game_text=Deploy on [[Death Star: Conference Room (V){{!}}Conference Room]]. [[Revolution]] is canceled. You may not deploy aliens (except bounty hunters and [[Mara Jade]]) or [Episode I] cards. Emperor and your admirals, generals, and moffs are Imperial Council Members and influence +1. While present, each Imperial Council Member adds one [Dark Side Force]. Once per turn, may use 1 Force to ▼ one [[Laser Gate (V){{!}}Laser Gate]] or a Political Effect. Your cards may deploy to table from Political Effects. May place your canceled Political Effect in Used Pile. [Immune to Alter]
|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[There Is No Try & •Oppressive Enforcement (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image on this page show this text. No published image shows the errata text; [[There Is No Try & •Oppressive Enforcement (V) (Errata)]] uses a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB4-34E-There_Is_No_Try_Oppressive_Enforcement-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 4 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Deploy on Conference Room. Revolution is canceled. You may not deploy aliens (except bounty hunters and Mara Jade) or [Episode I] cards. Emperor and your admirals, generals, and moffs are Imperial Council Members and influence +1. While present, each Imperial Council Member adds one [Dark Side Force]. Once per turn, may use 1 Force to ▼ one Laser Gate or a Political Effect. Your cards may deploy to table from Political Effects. May place your canceled Political Effect in Used Pile. [Immune to Alter]”. The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) prints the same text with the icons written out as words (“deploy one Laser Gate or a Political Effect from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”, “(Immune to Alter.)”) and marks the entry “Errata Text - September 9th, 2009”; that is not a separate version.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="cl-1240_36-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[There Is No Try & •Oppressive Enforcement (V) (Errata)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) added “here” after “While present”: “Deploy on Conference Room. Revolution is canceled. You may not deploy aliens (except bounty hunters and Mara Jade) or [Episode I] cards. Emperor and your admirals, generals, and moffs are Imperial Council Members and influence +1. While present here, each Imperial Council Member adds one [Dark Side Force]. Once per turn, may use 1 Force to ▼ one Laser Gate or a Political Effect. Your cards may deploy to table from Political Effects. May place your canceled Political Effect in Used Pile. [Immune to Alter]”.<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee announced this change on 19 October 2012, effective immediately (“The 5th sentence on this card should read: 'While present here, each Imperial Council Member adds one [DS icon].'”, “certainly not intended to be a global effect”)<ref name="pcforum-p761411">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574), post by Aglets, 19 October 2012 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20150320030739/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/forums/viewtopic.php?f=871&t=36574#p761411 Internet Archive copy], captured 20 March 2015)</ref>.
